title: Malaysian Shrimp Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with succulent shrimp, crunchy noodles, and a hint of zesty spice. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Add the bean sprouts, zesty sauce, soy sauce, and sugar to the skillet.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Return the cooked shrimp to the skillet and toss with the noodle mixture.
Sprinkle with crushed peanuts and chopped cilantro.
